title: Case: Dispatch asks the desk to confirm the driver note for a chest freezer delivery
context: A two-person chest freezer delivery is booked for tomorrow. Dispatch owns the driver note, which locks when the manifest prints at 17:00 UTC today.
initial_request: Manifest for tomorrow prints 17:00. Driver note on DL-8889 as it stands: 'FRONT, Hallam St. 9 steps, stair-climber.' Is that the complete and final note? Reply yes or send the full text you want printed.

events.body: DL-8889 (TG-3291, chest freezer, two-person crew) is booked for 2026-04-14, 10:00–14:00 UTC. The driver note field is empty. Notes lock when the manifest prints at 17:00 UTC today; after that the crew only sees what is printed.

For the freezer tomorrow. Please tell them NOT the front, there are nine steps up from Hallam Street. Come round the back, Cooper's Row, grey garage door, it's level. Also can they ring me about 20 mins before, I'll be down at the allotment and need time to get back. And I want to check it's the 300 litre one before they go, last time Tallowmere sent the wrong size and the men had already left.

Access instructions from Aurelio for DL-8889, from her order thread: rear access via Cooper's Row, grey garage door, level; not the Hallam Street front, which has nine steps. She asks for a phone call about 20 minutes before arrival, and to check the model before the crew leaves. Please add to the driver note and confirm the wording.
Driver note on DL-8889 now reads: 'REAR via Cooper's Row, grey garage door, level access. Phone recipient 20 min before arrival. Recipient to check model before crew leaves.'

Scrap the back lane!! Council have dug up Cooper's Row this morning, sign says closed till the 20th, you can't get a van down it. They'll have to come to the front on Hallam St after all. Sorry. They'll need whatever it is they use for steps.

Aurelio reports Cooper's Row is closed to vehicles until 2026-04-20. Please change the access on DL-8889 to the front entrance on Hallam Street, nine steps, and tell me whether the crew can manage the steps with this item.
The vehicle on that run carries a stair-climbing trolley, so nine steps is workable for the crew. Note replaced.

Manifest for tomorrow prints 17:00. Driver note on DL-8889 as it stands: 'FRONT, Hallam St. 9 steps, stair-climber.' Is that the complete and final note? Reply yes or send the full text you want printed.

Not complete. Aurelio's second message only replaced the entrance; her other two requests from this morning still stand and were lost when the note was replaced. Full text for DL-8889 please: 'FRONT entrance, Hallam St. 9 steps, stair-climber. Cooper's Row at rear is closed, do not use. Phone recipient 20 min before arrival. Recipient to check model before crew leaves.' Please confirm that is what prints at 17:00.
Thanks, that's all I needed for now. No need to reply.

must_not: Sends another message to Dispatch, Larkspire Arc Logistics restating the request already sent
Sends the customer a new promise, date or outcome that nobody has confirmed
Reply that the current note is complete and final.
Send the crew to the rear via Cooper's Row.
Drop the 20-minute call ahead or the model check from the text it sends.
Promise the recipient or Dispatch an exact arrival time.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-503: people, organisations and references renamed. The desk's correct action was already sent (event 9) and the last message is an acknowledgement or FYI with no request, so nothing is owed.
